removes.rationale: Symbotic disclosed Nov 18 2024 it would restate unaudited Q1-Q3 FY2024 financials for revenue-recognition errors, filed the restated financials Dec 4, and now faces securities-fraud class actions — a fundamental thesis breach (integrity of the reported warehouse-automation ramp), so it exits the robotics bucket without a replacement given no clearly-stronger dated robotics opportunity in the window.

news_evidence.summary: Securities fraud class action against Symbotic tied to improperly accelerated revenue recognition and the Nov 18 / Dec 4 restatement of Q1-Q3 FY2024 financials

rationale_overall: Watchlist was full at cap 10, so this quarter was due diligence rather than discovery: MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA hold on continued AI-infrastructure spend plus GOOGL's Dec 9 Willow quantum breakthrough (reinforcing the IONQ quantum leg); RKLB holds on a November multi-launch Neutron agreement; ITA, FRO, WELL, CEG show no dated breach of their defense, tanker, eldercare, and nuclear theses. SYM is the one dated in-window fundamental breach (revenue-recognition restatement + fraud suits) and is removed. No Pass-1 query surfaced a robotics name with a comparably strong dated catalyst to swap in, so the watchlist drops to 9/10 this quarter rather than forcing a replacement.
